title: An Upper Bound for Discrete Isometric Filling of Cycles
summary: We study the discrete graph-metric analogue of Gromov's filling area problem for the cycle graph \(C_n\). An abstract triangulation \(K\) is an isometric filling of \(C_n\) if \(\partial K=C_n\) and the graph distance between any two boundary vertices is not shortened inside the \(1\)-skeleton of \(K\).
